title: Evolved Spiking Neural Networks for EEG Seizure Detection: Calcium Dynamics and Delay Mechanics
summary: The EONS neuroevolution framework searched spiking-network topology and parameters for EEG seizure detection. Per-neuron calcium improved held-out CHB-MIT results and showed a smaller result in patient-disjoint Siena splits; this supports a bounded detector-search finding, not biological calcium dynamics.
ai_technology: EONS neuroevolution of spiking neural networks with integrate-and-fire calcium currents
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: On 10 held-out CHB-MIT patients, per-neuron calcium raised MCC from 0.592 to 0.726 across 20 runs; Siena patient-disjoint splits showed gains of +0.096 and +0.059 MCC.
evidence.unknown: More datasets and neuromorphic-hardware testing are needed; results do not establish clinical deployment.
